title: Humor@IITK at SemEval-2021 Task 7: Large Language Models for Quantifying Humor and Offensiveness
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on quantifying humor and offensiveness in text.
base_benchmarks: SemEval-2021 Task 7: HaHackathon: Detecting and Rating Humor and Offense
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the research.
